summary: This drug includes a liver warning because it contains acetaminophen, noting that severe liver damage can happen if you take more than 4,000 mg in 24 hours, take it with other acetaminophen products, or have 3 or more alcoholic drinks a day while using it [3]. It also features an allergy alert warning that acetaminophen may cause severe skin reactions [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a low score for liver concerns and a medium score for heart concerns [M].
